name: modulit-pro-av-finder
description: Find professional AV equipment and installation guides in the Modulit EU and Polish catalogues, size cable runs and configure AV hardware.

interface.longDescription: Find professional audiovisual equipment and published installation guides in Modulit’s EU and Polish catalogues. Match products to your signal format and cable run, compare alternatives, or build a PureLink Mediahub parts list. Results link to Modulit guides and product pages. Product lookups show suggested retail prices (MSRP, excluding VAT) and availability when the selected storefront makes them public.
defaultPrompt: Find two cables for 4K60 HDMI over 40 metres on the Polish Modulit site. Link the matching models.
Find a Modulit guide for extending a USB camera and microphone in a meeting room.
Configure three PureLink Mediahub ENC10 sets using preset 1. Show parts per set and in total.
